summary: Missing 15-year-old male in the Pleasant Park Road area
notes: Alpine 2015 Missions PDF item 15-05. SARDOC Feb 7 2015 mission report: 15-year-old male missing from Ridge Road, Conifer, after a fight with grandparents (school issues); had made suicide threats, left notes, and several firearms were missing from the home. Jeffco SO bloodhound found no tracks leaving the house in snow, then showed interest in a footprint south of the house; four SARDOC teams fielded (two with deputy support, two held at base), plus a Flight for Life helicopter; SARDOC air-scent teams worked until dark. Subject located the following morning in good shape.
